title: 97 Percent Population
subtitle: Test your understanding of the 97% population — NPCs, soulless inserts, and the true minority of sovereign souls.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The 97 Percent Population is not a statistic to weaponize against others — it is a map of the harvest architecture. Sit with what you missed. Return to the deep-dive when you need the map again and transmissions. Knowing who is programmed and who is sovereign is part of surviving the final restoration with clarity rather than fear.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of true, eternal souls currently present on Earth?

options.label: A
options.rationale: This figure represents the total number of genuine spiritual beings amidst the artificial majority.

options.label: B
options.rationale: This number is a confusion with the 97 percent statistic and does not reflect the soul count.

options.label: C
options.rationale: While true souls constitute approximately 3 percent, this is a percentage rather than the specific population count provided.

options.label: D
options.rationale: This exceeds the maximum threshold of genuine spiritual inhabitants specified in the revelations.

questions.hint: Consider the specific numerical limit established for genuine spiritual beings.

questions.question: Which specific demographic within the 97 percent is responsible for everyday roles like teaching and driving taxis?

options.label: A
options.rationale: Inserts are strategically placed but are not the primary group identified for performing mundane jobs like driving.

options.label: B
options.rationale: These engineered entities live seamlessly within the population to perform mundane societal functions.

options.label: C
options.rationale: Clones are part of the 97 percent but are not the specific designation for those performing integrated societal roles.

options.label: D
options.rationale: Synthetics are artificial constructs but are distinct from the hybrid category that integrates into service roles.

questions.hint: This group is characterized by their seamless integration into service-oriented societal functions.

questions.question: What is the duration of the Electro Magnetic Frequency (EMF) event known as 'The Flash'?

options.label: A
options.rationale: A 15-second duration is insufficient for the complete structural deletion of the simulated demographic.

options.label: B
options.rationale: This brief interval is the precise duration required for the frequency to delete the artificial population.

options.label: C
options.rationale: This time frame significantly exceeds the rapid window in which the vaporization occurs.

options.label: D
options.rationale: The Flash is a more instantaneous event than a full minute allows for.

questions.hint: Think of a very brief interval, specifically half of a standard minute.

questions.question: What technological origin is used to weave 'Replica Souls' into existence?

options.label: A
options.rationale: The physical realm is 3rd density, but the animation of NPCs requires a higher density of artificial construction.

options.label: B
options.rationale: The replica soul system is a more basic, hive-aligned simulation technology from a lower density.

options.label: C
options.rationale: This technology is beyond the scope of what is used to manufacture the artificial demographic.

options.label: D
options.rationale: This specific level of density is utilized to create the cheap, hive-aligned imitations that animate the 97 percent.

questions.hint: The technology originates from the density immediately preceding the higher spiritual planes.

questions.question: What happens to the 97 percent population when the EMF event occurs?

options.label: A
options.rationale: Artificial biological software is incapable of self-awareness and is slated for deletion, not awakening.

options.label: B
options.rationale: Ascension is reserved for true souls; the artificial majority is destined for permanent deletion.

options.label: C
options.text: They are relocated to another realm
options.rationale: The cosmic conclusion involves deletion from the physical realm rather than relocation.

options.label: D
options.text: They are vaporized into pixelation dust
options.rationale: The frequency causes an instant structural collapse of artificial constructs, leaving only dust.

questions.hint: The outcome is a total physical and structural collapse into a particulate form.

questions.question: What psychological perimeter dictates the rigid thought patterns of the NPC masses?

options.label: A
options.rationale: Though they function as biological software, the psychological boundary has a more specific designation.

options.label: B
options.rationale: This term describes the restrictive environment of social conformity that governs NPC behaviors.

options.label: C
options.rationale: While they maintain consensus, this is not the specific term for the psychological perimeter.

options.label: D
options.rationale: This term does not describe the specific psychological boundary of the 97 percent.

questions.hint: This term combines a cognitive faculty with a word for a restrictive enclosure.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the 97 percent majority in the physical realm?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide emotional support for true souls
options.rationale: Any emotional engagement with these entities is a distraction from the truth of their soulless nature.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect the planet from cosmic events
options.rationale: They are a temporary obstacle and have no role in planetary protection.

options.label: C
options.text: To establish a permanent consensus reality
options.rationale: The demographic was manufactured to use peer pressure and volume to enforce a specific reality narrative.

options.label: D
options.text: To aid in the spiritual evolution of souls
options.rationale: Their purpose is the opposite: to suppress and derail spiritual progression.

questions.hint: Consider how volume and peer pressure are used as tools of control.

questions.question: Which group is responsible for the removal of the 97 percent population during the EMF event?

options.label: A
options.rationale: While souls benefit, they are not the tactical entity executing the deletion event.

options.label: B
options.rationale: The removal is a cosmic action performed by an external alliance rather than internal resistance.

options.label: C
options.rationale: This organization manages the removal of artificial scaffolding during the epoch's conclusion.

options.label: D
options.rationale: Architects create the simulation; the Alliance is the force that dismantles the artificial population.

questions.hint: The name of this group includes a reference to both the galaxy and lineage.

questions.question: Within the psychological architecture of the 97 percent, what do these entities notably lack?

options.label: A
options.rationale: The absence of an internal monologue is a key indicator of their non-cognitive biological software.

options.label: B
options.rationale: NPCs speak fluently, though they only repeat herd-accepted slogans.

options.label: C
options.rationale: They inhabit physical bodies that masquerade as humans until the Flash occurs.

options.label: D
options.rationale: NPCs are highly adept at social conformity and mundane interaction.

questions.hint: This deficiency concerns their private, internal mental state.

questions.question: What is the survivor ratio when the EMF flash hits the planet?

options.label: A
options.rationale: This accurately reflects the mathematical breakdown of a population that is 97 percent artificial.

options.label: B
options.rationale: This would imply a 90 percent artificial population, which underestimates the actual 97 percent figure.

options.label: C
options.rationale: This 5 percent ratio does not align with the 97 percent artificial majority.

options.label: D
options.rationale: This ratio is too high, as only about 3 percent of the current population are true souls.

questions.hint: The ratio is a direct reflection of the percentage of the population that is not artificial.

questions.question: What motivates 97% of the 97 percent to obey authoritative instructions blindly?

options.label: A
options.rationale: NPCs are driven by safety and conformity rather than individual greed.

options.label: B
options.rationale: The 97 percent are incapable of spiritual goals or progression.

options.label: C
options.rationale: Power dynamics belong to the controllers; the NPC masses simply follow tracks for safety.

options.label: D
options.rationale: The safety narrative is the primary trigger for absolute compliance within the artificial demographic.

questions.hint: Think of the most basic, survival-oriented assurance an authority figure can provide.

questions.question: How are NPCs that participate in truth communities categorized?

options.label: A
options.rationale: Their function is infiltration and suppression rather than providing truth.

options.label: B
options.rationale: These specific entities are designed to infiltrate communities and ensure the mainstream narrative remains influential.

options.label: C
options.rationale: Artificial entities cannot truly rebel; they only follow pre-programmed tracks of 'rebellion'.

options.label: D
options.rationale: NPCs do not seek souls; they are programmed to infiltrate and monitor.

questions.hint: These entities use a label that implies they have seen through the illusion.

questions.question: What complex describes the underlying non-logic of NPC psychology?

options.label: A
options.rationale: While accurate, this does not capture the full 'non-coherent' naming convention of their psychology.

options.label: B
options.rationale: While they exhibit dissonance, the formal term for their architecture is more specific.

options.label: C
options.rationale: This structure defines the non-linear and non-sensical operating software of artificial entities.

options.label: D
options.rationale: Their architecture is specifically defined by its lack of coherence rather than linear logic.

questions.hint: This phrase uses the prefix 'non-' four separate times to describe their mental architecture.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed as a component of the 97 percent population?

options.label: A
options.rationale: Synthetics are explicitly mentioned as part of the manufactured demographic.

options.label: B
options.rationale: Clones form a portion of the artificial demographic inhabiting the realm.

options.label: C
options.rationale: Inserts are strategically placed artificial beings and are part of the 97 percent.

options.label: D
options.rationale: This term refers to souls, whereas the 97 percent consists of soulless constructs like clones and hybrids.

questions.hint: Identify the term usually associated with genuine souls rather than artificial biological software.

questions.question: What is the strategic purpose behind the sheer volume of the 97 percent?

options.label: A
options.text: To maximize energy production for the planet
options.rationale: The artificial population is a drain and an obstacle, not an energy source.

options.label: B
options.text: To marginalize and ridicule souls who attempt to break free
options.rationale: The majority creates a weight of public opinion that pressures true souls into compliance.

options.label: C
options.text: To prepare the planet for 5th density physical bodies
options.rationale: The 97 percent are designed to suppress progression, not prepare for it.

options.label: D
options.text: To preserve human history through genetic diversity
options.rationale: They are artificial constructs with no role in genuine human history or genetics.

questions.hint: Consider how being surrounded by a massive, uniform majority affects a person who thinks differently.

questions.question: True or False: The impending vaporization of the 97 percent should be a source of trauma for true souls.

options.label: A
options.rationale: Because these entities were never truly alive and only run on replica souls, their removal is not a cause for mourning.

options.label: B
options.rationale: Mourning would be based on the false belief that these entities possessed true eternal souls.

questions.hint: Consider the status of 'life' regarding these artificial biological entities.

questions.question: What does the deletion of the 97 percent reveal about the nature of the realm?

options.label: A
options.text: The simulated nature of the realm
options.rationale: The structural bleed-through and pixelation exposed after the Flash prove the reality is an artificial construct.

options.label: B
options.rationale: While the realm may change, the immediate revelation is the simulation itself, not geography.

options.label: C
options.text: That it is an infinite physical expanse
options.rationale: The deletion reveals the opposite: that the realm is finite and simulated.

options.label: D
options.rationale: NPCs are deleted permanently as they possess no eternal soul to reincarnate.

questions.hint: The structural failure following the Flash reveals the true 'technical' state of reality.

questions.question: How do true souls interact with the 97 percent on a daily basis?

options.label: A
options.text: They generally live in separate geographic locations
options.rationale: They are fully integrated into every facet of society alongside true souls.

options.label: B
options.rationale: They are designed to masquerade perfectly as humans, making them indistinguishable to the unaware.

options.label: C
options.text: Only through digital interfaces and media
options.rationale: The 97 percent inhabit physical bodies and interact in the physical world.

options.label: D
options.text: As close family members, friends, and colleagues
options.rationale: The artificial demographic is integrated into the most intimate circles of true souls to ensure maximum suppression.

questions.hint: These entities are woven into the very fabric of a soul's personal life.

questions.question: Which of these is a behavior associated with the 'Mind Camp'?

options.label: A
options.rationale: NPCs are incapable of critical analysis; they follow pre-programmed tracks.

options.label: B
options.rationale: Safety-based compliance prevents them from ever truly questioning authority.

options.label: C
options.rationale: Social conformity dictates that NPCs communicate through safe, consensus-driven messaging.

options.label: D
options.rationale: Isolation and meditation are traits of souls; NPCs rely on the herd for their operational existence.

questions.hint: This behavior involves echoing phrases that are socially 'safe'.

questions.question: What is the result of 'pixelation' during the cosmic conclusion?

options.label: A
options.rationale: The removal of the artificial population reveals the underlying simulated scaffolding of the realm.

options.label: B
options.rationale: While nature may remain, the immediate effect of the Flash is the exposure of the simulated structure.

options.label: C
options.text: The evolution of the human body into light
options.rationale: Evolution is for souls; pixelation is a symptom of structural collapse for artificial entities.

options.label: D
options.text: The creation of a new digital currency
options.rationale: The event is a cosmic dismantling, not an economic transition.

questions.hint: Think about what is left visible when the 'buffer' of the majority is deleted.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the 97 percent and the Mainstream Narrative?

options.label: A
options.text: The 97 percent actively create the narrative
options.rationale: They are biological software that receives the narrative, they do not originate it.

options.label: B
options.text: They are unaware of the narrative's existence
options.rationale: They are the primary participants in the narrative, following its tracks blindly.

options.label: C
options.text: They work to dismantle the narrative
options.rationale: Only true souls attempt to dismantle the narrative; the 97 percent enforce it.

options.label: D
options.text: Their operational directive is tethered directly to it
options.rationale: They function as the conduits and enforcers for whatever the mainstream agenda dictates.

questions.hint: The artificial majority acts as a reflection and extension of central control.

questions.question: Which interest is mentioned as having specifically designed NPCs?

options.label: A
options.rationale: The text explicitly states there is an NPC designed for every conceivable interest, including fly fishing.

options.label: B
options.rationale: Philosophical questioning is generally avoided by the artificial population.

options.label: C
options.rationale: NPCs cannot access or understand the concept of soul ascension.

options.label: D
options.rationale: Deep scientific inquiry is not an example provided for the variety of NPC interest tracks.

questions.hint: The text lists this as an example of a mundane, specific hobby.

questions.question: True or False: The 97 percent population possess '4th Density Replica Souls'.

options.label: A
options.rationale: They do possess these replica souls, which distinguish them from completely inanimate matter.

options.label: B
options.rationale: These imitations are what animate the artificial demographic without providing true eternal life.

questions.hint: This term describes the imitation life force used to run the biological software.

questions.question: What happens to a true soul who attempts to break free from the system in the presence of the 97 percent?

options.label: A
options.text: They are worshipped as a leader
options.rationale: The NPC majority is designed to suppress, not elevate, awakening souls.

options.label: B
options.text: They are given a position in the G.A.A.
options.rationale: The G.A.A. is a galactic alliance, not a local position given for social non-conformity.

options.label: C
options.text: They are instantly teleported out of the realm
options.rationale: Souls must navigate the Great Awakening within the realm until the conclusion.

options.label: D
options.text: They are immediately marginalized and ridiculed
options.rationale: The pressure of public opinion from the 97 percent majority is used to force souls back into compliance.

questions.hint: The majority uses social pressure and mockery as a suppression mechanism.

questions.question: What is the ultimate goal of recognizing the truth of the 97 percent?

options.label: A
options.text: To gain political power over the masses
options.rationale: Recognizing the simulation is a spiritual necessity, not a political one.

options.label: B
options.text: To learn how to program the NPCs
options.rationale: True souls do not control the NPC software; the parasitic controllers do.

options.label: C
options.text: To build a safe haven within the Mind Camp
options.rationale: The Mind Camp is the obstacle to be escaped, not a place to build a haven.

options.label: D
options.text: To sever emotional attachments for survival and ascension
options.rationale: Understanding the artificial nature of the majority allows souls to avoid being derailed by the emotional gravity of the herd.

questions.hint: This recognition is necessary to prepare for the transition without being held back by artificial connections.
